definitions.full: H1935. hod I. הוֺד noun masculine Job 37:22 splendour, majesty, vigour (chiefly in poetry) (Late Hebrew id. ) — ׳ה absolute 37:22 8 t. ( ׳הַה 1Chr 29:11 ); construct Isa 30:30 3 t.; suffix הוֺדִי Dan 10:8 ; הוֺדְךָ Num 27:20 2 t.; הוֺדֶ֑ךָ Prov 5:9 ; Psa 145:4 ; הוֺדוֺ Hosea 14:7 3 t.; הֹדֹה Jer 22:18 ; — 1 splendour, majesty , of king וַהֲדָרֶ֑ךָ הוֺדְךָ Psa 45:4 ; עָלָיו תְּשַׁוֶּה וְהָדָר הוֺד 21:6 , subject ׳י (|| בִּישׁוּעָתֶ֑ךָ כְּבוֺדוֺ גָּדוֺל ); foretold of the צֶמַח Zech 6:13 עַלכִּֿסְאוֺ וּמָשַׁל וְיָשַׁב הוֺד וְהוּאיִֿשָּׂא ; compare מַלְכוּת הוֺד עָלָיו וַיִּתֵּן 1Chr 29:25 ( ׳י confers on Solomon); מַלְכוּת ה עָלָיו ָנתְנוּ ׳וְלֹא Dan 11:21 (of usurper); see also הֹדֹה וְהוֺי Jer 22:18 in lament for king. Hence also 2 divine splendour, majesty , light & glory which God wears as king: לָבָ֑שְׁתָּ וְהָדָר הוֺד Psa 104:1 (7 t. joined with הָדָר ); compare Job 40:10 where ׳י addresses Job in irony: הוֺד נוֺרָא עַלאֱֿלוֺהַּ 37:22 ; ׳ה לְפָנָיו וְהָדָר Psa 96:6 = 1Chr 16:26 ; also וְהַה וְהַנֵּצַח וְהַתִּפְאֶרֶת ׳וְהַגְּבוּרָה הַגְּדֻלָּה 29:11 ; see further הוֺדוֺ שָׁמַיִם כִּסָּה Hab 3:3 (|| הָאָ֑רֶץ מָֽלְאָה וּתְהִלָּתוֺ ); עַלהַֿשָּׁמַיִם הוֺדְךָ אֲשֶׁרתְּֿנָה Psa 8:2 (|| שִׁמְךָ מָהאַֿדִּיר בְּכָלהָֿאָ֑רֶץ ); also וְשָׁמָ֑יִם עַלאֶֿרֶץ הוֺדוֺ 148:13 (|| לְבַדּוֺ שְׁמוֺ נִשְׁגָּב ); הוֺדֶ֑ךָ כְּבוֺד הֲדַר 145:4 ; of Yahweh's actions מָּעֳלוֺ וְהָדָר הוֺד 111:3 ; of his voice י ׳זְהִשְׁמִיעַ קוֺלוֺ אֶתהֿוֺד Isa 30:30 . 3. a. splendour of Israel under divine blessing הוֺדוֺ כַזַּיִת וִיהִי Hosea 14:7 . b. majesty, dignity, authority of Moses Num 27:20 (P; only here in Hexateuch) עָלָיו מֵהוֺדְךָ וְנָתַתָּ . Also, c. manly vigour מֶּןתִּֿתֵּן הוֺדֶ֑ךָ לַאֲחֵרִים Prov 5:9 , in warning against licentiousness; as displayed in outward appearance לְמַשְׁחִית עָלַי נֶהְמַּךְ וְהוֺדִי Dan 10:8 (|| כֹּחַ ). 4 of a horse , majesty, majestic force אֵימָה נַחְרוֺ הוֺד Job 39:20 the majesty of his snorting (majestic snorting , VB) is a terror ; also in simile of Yahweh's dealings with Judah, בַּמִּלְחָמָה הוֺדוֺ כְּסוּס אוֺתָם וְשָׂם Zech 10:3 and he will make them like the horse of his majesty in battle .

occurrences.englishText: You shall give authority to him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may obey.
Honor and majesty are before him.

Yours, Yahweh, is the greatness, the power, the glory, the victory, and the majesty! For all that is in the heavens and in the earth is yours. Yours is the kingdom, Yahweh, and you are exalted as head above all.
Yahweh magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and gave to him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.
Out of the north comes golden splendor.
Have you made him to leap as a locust?
“Now deck yourself with excellency and dignity.
From the lips of babes and infants you have established strength,
For you make him most blessed forever.
In your majesty ride on victoriously on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness.
Honor and majesty are before him.
Bless Yahweh, my soul.
His work is honor and majesty.
I will meditate on the glorious majesty of your honor,
let them praise Yahweh’s name,
lest you give your honor to others,
Yahweh will cause his glorious voice to be heard, and will show the descent of his arm, with the indignation of his anger, and the flame of a devouring fire, with a blast, storm, and hailstones.
Therefore Yahweh says concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah:
So I was left alone, and saw this great vision. No strength remained in me; for my face grew deathly pale, and I retained no strength.
“In his place a contemptible person will stand up, to whom they had not given the honor of the kingdom; but he will come in time of security, and will obtain the kingdom by flatteries.
Men will dwell in his shade.
God came from Teman,
even he shall build Yahweh’s temple; and he shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule on his throne; and he shall be a priest on his throne; and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.
My anger is kindled against the shepherds,
